title: Cebu gov to convene forum on air quality, class suspensions

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol —The Cebu provincial government will convene medical experts, education officials, local government leaders, and parent representatives on Tuesday to discuss air quality concerns and guidelines for class suspensions. Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro set the open forum at 3 p.m. at the Capitol Social Hall to address growing concerns among parents, teachers, and students over air pollution and its possible effects on children’s health. Baricuatro said the provincial government recognizes the need to prioritize children’s health and safety while ensuring that decisions on class suspensions are guided by reliable information and expert advice.
